data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Rikos', meaning 'power, strength, ruler'. In Christian tradition, Rici is associated with St. Ricius, a 4th-century Roman martyr. The name Rici carries the meaning “Power, Strength, Ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rici usually hope their child will grow to embody power, strength, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Rici belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Power, Strength, Ruler.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rici total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
data.cultural_impact: The name "Rici" holds a rich cultural heritage, derived from the Greek name 'Rikos'. It carries the sense of power, strength, and rulership. This name was popular during the Roman era and further reinforced through Christian tradition with the story of St. Ricius, highlighting the enduring influence of this name in history and culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Rici is a name deeply rooted in Christian spirituality, as it is associated with St. Ricius. In the midst of persecution for his faith during the 4th century, St. Ricius embodied strength, courage, and unwavering commitment to his beliefs. Named after him, the name "Rici" serves as a constant reminder of the powers of faith, strength, and resilience in the midst of adversity.
